scope: Entire candidate controller_handoff.py, including Route, history verifier, Admission, parent Coordinator and restart_controller
Relevant actual Session validation, observer/ACK and resource binding interfaces
independent_read_review.not_self_review: Parent coordinator and Session are root-owned; the two entrance changes and V2 registration module are this author's work and not independent self-validation.
supported_read_observations: Source stop requires a live captured observer, ACK verification and kernel exit before grant reservation.
Reservation and SPAWNING are committed/read back before Popen; incomplete or repeated requests cannot spawn a second successor.
Actual birth identity and per-message kernel credentials precede ISSUED; child consume is integrated with the same registration/head/session writer.
PREPARED/COMMIT/STARTED separate resource preparation from successor continuation; unknown response does not grant a new launch.

open_reported_finding.status: read-only suspicion sent to root, not tested by this author and not counted as a red
open_reported_finding.code_location: _Admission.mark_started: after COMMIT receipt, before STARTED write
open_reported_finding.detail: Resource witnesses are checked before PREPARED, but the second critical section checks only ctx/route. Session runtime validation does not recheck GPU FD/list or PID-file witnesses. A controlled resource change during the COMMIT wait may therefore retain stale resource-ready authority. Root was asked to reproduce independently before a narrow fix.

limits: No independent real successor process or full grant-commit tests executed in this report; runtime agent owns product-level proof.
Aggregate closed-history membership is bounded at 4096 across generations; protocol grants at most 64 successors. No indefinite handoff lifetime claim.
Strong private capability/current-head checks do not sandbox arbitrary same-process or same-UID hostile code.
No full Core/Pro results attributed to this author.

final_followup.historical_note: The original open finding and read hashes above describe the first candidate review and are deliberately retained.
final_followup.finding_resolution: Root factored _check_resources and calls it again under context+GPU registry locks after COMMIT and before STARTED. This author read the complete narrow fix at cd2f91f8 and found the reported resource window addressed.

observed_original_product_neighbor.note: Same actual run documented in the Observer report, not an additional six-test run.

final_followup.no_extra_authorship: Actual resource fault regression and fix were performed by runtime/root respectively, not this author; no draft-red count transferred into this report.
